title: Salman's Long Search for Truth
paragraphs: Before finding Islam, Salman al-Farisi traveled through several countries and studied under multiple religious teachers, searching persistently for a truth that none of his previous mentors could fully satisfy.
Along this long journey, he was sold into slavery more than once, yet he continued seeking answers to his questions rather than abandoning his search out of frustration or exhaustion.
When he finally encountered the Prophet ﷺ, Salman tested several specific signs his last teacher had described, wanting genuine confirmation rather than simply accepting claims based on faith alone.
His years of patient searching are often mentioned today when discussing the value of genuinely seeking answers rather than settling comfortably for the first available explanation.
